Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pacers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the 76ers win 54 times in 100; most games like this end between 206 and 255 total points.

analyst.text: Tyrese Haliburton practised on Wednesday after missing 14 straight games with a hamstring strain, and Rick Carlisle answered 'stay tuned' when asked about Friday. Indiana come in off a 125-120 win over Oklahoma City. Philadelphia (2-1) are playing for East Group B, while Joel Embiid has been out ill. A Haliburton return or another Embiid absence would tilt a near coin-flip towards Indiana; check the late injury report.
